In 1949, Mr. Kihachiro Onitsuka began his athletic footwear company (Onitsuka Co., Ltd.) by manufacturing basketball shoes out of his living room in Kobe, Japan. He chose the name ASICS for his company in 1977, based on a famous Latin phrase "Anima Sana In Corpore Sano," which, when translated, expresses the ancient ideal of "A Sound Mind in a Sound Body." Taking the acronym of this phrase, ASICS was founded on the belief that the best way to create a healthy and happy lifestyle is to promote total health and fitness. Today, ASICS offers a full line of performance-driven athletic shoes and technical active sports apparel and accessories dedicated to bringing harmony to the body and soul.

recommendations.title: Nike Mens Flyknit Lunar 2, VOLT/BLACK-PHOTO BLUE-ELCTRC GREEN, 9.5 M US
description: One of Nike's hottest styles to date, Flyknit Lunar, gets revamped in the Nike Flyknit Lunar 2+ running shoe. Made to take on the miles with style, these bold running shoes are ready to tackle the road, the treadmill and beyond. The dynamic Flyknit upper and ultra-cushioned Lunarlon midsole are still there, but the styling is as aggressive and sleek as ever. The Flyknit upper features a new and unique zig-zag color blocking, but the real standout is the contoured fit. Made of single-layer polyester yarn, the material is woven tighter in areas where more support is needed and looser in areas where flexibility is a must, for total comfort and plenty of support. Rugged and constructed for traction, the outsole features rubber lugs for superior grip, as well as a speckled design for extra style points. Added Bonus: The Flyknit Lunar2 is made with environmentally preferred rubber, while the polyester yarn fabric on the upper is produced in such a way that creates little to no waste. The result: A performance powerhouse that you can feel good about.
